'''2011 Bespin Regionals Nick Swedal LS Local Uprising''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Swedal]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Speedy Hoth
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
